base_plant: v0.13 positive-volume collar with arbitrary two-class q disturbance

initial_state.parameter: registered nonempty set I subseteq S
initial_state.knowledge: controller knows I but not the adversarially selected actual initial sensor state

transducer.parameter: finite S, finite raw Y, and nonempty support E(s,z) subseteq Y x S
transducer.charging: raw output word and normal cell are separately injective
transducer.normal_channel: depends only on n and cannot encode initial sensor state, mode, or event
transducer.safety_quantifier: every initial sensor state in I, disturbance word, and supported event word

theorem.feasibility: every reachable transition from B_0=I has singleton current q set
